_comment: Drop-in Claude Desktop / Cursor MCP config for the SZL Hatun-MCP server (23 static tools: 17 szl_* + 6 governance). Endpoint is hatun-mcp (the fleet's only spec-compliant MCP transport) — NOT a11oy, whose /mcp/ serves the web UI and rejects JSON-RPC with HTTP 405. Trailing slash on /mcp/ is required; Accept must include both application/json and text/event-stream; an SZL API key (Authorization: Bearer szl_...) is required. Doctrine v11 · Apache-2.0.
